messages:
Riley (AE): Heads-up: HelioPay sent an RFP + security questionnaire. They require an on-prem HSM option, embedding throughput examples, and a short POC plan. Need draft response by tomorrow noon.
Nadia (SE): I'll take the tech parts. Early notes: HSM support differs by deployment: Hosted = cloud KMS only; Dedicated can optionally attach HSM in provider network; Private supports BYO-HSM but requires cert validation.
Diego (Infra): Timeline constraints: Hosted PoC (no HSM) = 24-48h to spin up. Dedicated reserved pool ~3 business days. Private BYO-HSM onboard needs vendor cert validation + ops window ~10 business days (could be more with strict egress rules).
Lena (Product): For throughput please include assumptions: model family, sequence length (8k), batch size, concurrency. Suggested phrasing: "Embeddings throughput (8k ctx) — Hosted: 60-140 rps (shared, variable); Dedicated: 350-650 rps (reserved GPU pool); Private: depends on GPU count, estimate 500+ rps per A100-equivalent GPU."
Marcus (Legal): We can do BYO-HSM with a tailored addendum. Require SOC2 + vendor attestation. Also need statement on data residency and retention limits. I'll prepare templated clause and list of docs we need.
Riley (AE): Good. Can we give a capability matrix snippet to paste in the RFP? Keep it concise.
Nadia (SE): Pasting CSV-ready matrix (for quick paste):
```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private
SLA,standard usage,99.9% reserved,99.95% enterprise private
HSM,cloud KMS only,optional provider-backed HSM,BYO-HSM (cert req)
Throughput (embeddings,8k),60-140 rps,350-650 rps,custom (gpu dependent)
Region controls,region-limited,regional clusters,customer-controlled
Audit logs,standard,extended,on-prem export
Network,egress allowed via NAT,peered VPCs,customer network only
Rollouts,model pinning,canary + A/B,canary + BYO fallback
```
Diego (Infra): Note: if HelioPay enforces zero egress, private air-gapped install is possible but adds 3-4 week lead due to packaging, security review, and support SLA limitations. Call that out as a blocker for an accelerated PoC.
Lena (Product): Also add a short line on fallback behavior: "Automatic fallback to lower-capacity quantized variant when latency/throughput thresholds breach; recommended monitoring + eval set to detect quality regressions."
Marcus (Legal): I've uploaded a DPA template and the BYO-HSM addendum draft to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/heliopay-rfp. I also attached the list of required customer docs.
DeployBot: Ticket created: INF-8237 for HelioPay private onboarding.
Riley (AE): Next steps: Nadia to add conditional language and timelines to matrix; Diego to confirm private lead times; Marcus to send legal attachments. I'll assemble and reply to the RFP with 3 options (fast hosted, mid dedicated, secure private) and explicit caveats.
Nadia (SE): Will update the matrix and include the quantization note + quality delta estimate (~2-5% depending on task).
Diego (Infra): Confirmed with ops: Dedicated capacity can be trialed for 7 days on a minimal commit; private BYO-HSM requires certs & test access, expect 10-15 business days for full validation.
Riley (AE): Thanks all. Ping me when drive doc updated and I'll send the response by 12:00 tomorrow.
Nadia (SE): Done. Pushed updated CSV and short POC runbook to drive. :thumbsup:
